g.text: Jevons saw coal use rise as engines got more
efficient. Cheaper units open uses that weren’t worth

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: If demand grows faster than price falls, total spend
rises. If not, you pay less and still do more.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Each login, email or log line is worth a sliver of a
cent to check. At LLM prices, most aren’t worth

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: A decision needs to be cheaper than its value and
faster than its deadline. Logins wait for no one:
they need an answer inside the few hundred
milliseconds a person will sit and wait.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: 8× more decisions, a quarter of the spend. Within one
company’s jobs the bill falls. New jobs are where the

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Flag a fixed share and reviews grow from 136 to 1,185
a day. Flag by cost and they stay put.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430

g.text: Next: six ways to make the same decision, in one fair contest.
